title: HealthDB
summary: A distributed key-value store in Rust built on the Raft consensus protocol, implemented from the paper: leader election, log replication, and heartbeats. Writes go through a write-ahead log with CRC32 integrity checks for crash-safe recovery, and nodes exchange AppendEntries/RequestVote RPCs over an async Tokio TCP layer with timeouts and retries.

title: What 2 Watch
summary: A "vibe-first" recommender that matches films, series, and anime by mood and tone using OpenAI embeddings and vector similarity instead of keyword overlap. A TMDB ingestion tool and Reddit scraper grow the SQLite catalog, and the Go/Gin + React app runs in Docker Compose behind Caddy with Cloudflare in front.

title: BLE Mesh Sensor Network
summary: A Bluetooth Mesh network of EFR32MG24 sensor nodes using a custom vendor model and opcodes for telemetry. A SiW917 gateway bridges the mesh to MQTT and Firebase Realtime Database with per-node state tracking, and a bidirectional command path lets a React Native app toggle LEDs and change sensor intervals remotely.

title: Sealbound
summary: A 2D narrative RPG in Godot where you restore the world through connection, not sacrifice, built with a small team. My contributions include collisions and Y-sorting, the save/load system, time-of-day lighting, bridges and teleports, and the dungeon reward screen. I also built the game's official landing page.

title: LockIN
summary: A native iOS app that shields distracting apps behind Screen Time; you earn unlock minutes by answering standardized-test questions and spend them on per-app usage time. The core is a framework-free Swift package (append-only ledger, difficulty-scaled earn engine, unlock controller) covered by 30 XCTest cases, wired to a Device Activity Monitor extension that auto-relocks and refunds on OS failure.

title: PL/0 Compiler
summary: A complete compiler for the PL/0 language written in C, with a lexical analyzer, parser, and code generator that emits code for the PM/0 stack machine. It handles procedures, recursion, control structures, and nested scoping, and ships with a PM/0 virtual machine to run the output.

title: Solaris Shell
summary: A Fallout-themed Unix shell written in C directly on POSIX process APIs. It tokenizes quoted arguments, runs programs with fork/execvp, and supports pipes, I/O redirection (>, >>, <), and built-ins dispatched through a function-pointer table.

title: Molecule Ray Tracer
tagline: GPU ray tracing for molecular structures
summary: An OpenGL 4.6 renderer that parses PDB protein/DNA files into atoms, computes a bounding volume, and uploads them to the GPU as a shader storage buffer. A GLSL compute shader casts a ray per pixel, intersects each atom as a sphere, and writes the image to a texture drawn on a full-screen quad.

title: Shadow of the Sword
summary: A souls-like dungeon crawler built in Unity by a four-person team in one semester, centered on attacking and parrying telegraphed enemy attacks. I owned the enemy AI and overall gameplay flow, the health and death systems, dash and parry timing, and in-world lore books.
